meta.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems Composite Parameters (pscomppars)
meta.query: select pl_name,hostname,hip_name,hd_name,ra,dec,sy_dist,sy_vmag,sy_gaiamag,sy_snum,sy_pnum,st_teff,st_rad,st_mass,st_lum,st_spectype,pl_orbper,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmax_reflink,pl_orbeccen,pl_orbincl,pl_orblper,pl_tranmid,pl_orbtper,pl_rade,pl_rade_reflink,pl_bmasse,pl_bmassprov,pl_eqt,pl_eqt_reflink,pl_insol,discoverymethod,disc_year,disc_facility,tran_flag,pl_controv_flag from pscomppars order by hostname, pl_name
meta.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the NASA Exoplanet Archive, which is operated by the California Institute of Technology, under contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration under the Exoplanet Exploration Program.
facilities: Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) Satellite Mission
University of Canterbury Mt John Observatory
meta.notes: Composite parameters mix publications; rCalc/aCalc/teqCalc mark archive-calculated values. n = letter after the host name (else name = full name); method/fac index the tables above. m = best mass (Earth masses); mk absent = true mass, s = minimum mass (M sin i), r = from a mass-radius relation. r = radius (Earth radii), a = AU, p = days, i/w = degrees, tr = transits. mvFrom: how a host's absolute V magnitude was obtained (V and distance, luminosity, radius and Teff, Gaia G as V, or a main-sequence mass relation). tc = transit midpoint / inferior conjunction (BJD), tp = periastron time (BJD). Host positions without 'star' are ICRS RA/Dec + archive distance in the engine axes (pc).
